rulings.ruling: Ruling: model error; iw2w3 p. 18, boxes 3 and 7 (social security wages and social security tips; amb.2025.ss_wages): person.wages is the sum of w2.wages, boxes 3 plus 7, the amount the excess social security tax test compares with the wage base (i1040gi p. 117, Line 11). Case inputs (fixtures/2025/classm.deepseek.json, classm.person.1.deepseek): emp_a box 1 $29,524.00, box 3 $29,524.00, box 7 $0.00; emp_b box 1 $0.00, box 3 $0.00, box 7 $15,230.00; so boxes 3 plus 7 total $44,754.00, the project's value. The model's work ("29,524.00 + 0.00 = 29,524.00") adds emp_a's amount and emp_b's box 3 (or box 1) and misses emp_b's box 7 tips of $15,230.00. Same case and ruling as round 2. A wrong worked value is not evidence; dropped.
